clips.title: The story
paras: Rumbleshot's Ammo is a mislaid crate of munitions bound for the gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh. Lost when a frightened courier fled from hungry wendigos, the heavy crate sits abandoned in the snow near the Grizzled Den.

Hegnar Rumbleshot operates a roadside arms shop along the mountain path leading down from Coldridge Pass toward Anvilmar. With Ironforge riflemen, mountaineers, and dwarven mortar teams constantly drilling in the snowy heights, his supplies burn away almost as fast as powder catches flame. This particular shipment of shot was dispatched by Loslor from Kharanos, but never reached the shelves. The courier tasked with transporting it pitched camp too close to the predatory wendigos of the Grizzled Den, panicked when attacked, and fled for his life, leaving the heavy supply crate sitting deep within the beast's hunting grounds.
